topic.title_zh: 电子工程、电路与信号系统
topic.question_zh: 从软件转向电子学，怎样把大学理论与能动手的电路和信号实验接起来？
topic.description_zh: 覆盖电路入门MOOC、动手教材、工程参考书与音频及动态系统应用；按数学背景和项目目标选择入口。

resources.title: MIT 18.085 Computational Science and Engineering I
resources.summary_zh: 把线性代数、微分方程和数值计算用于科学及工程问题，适合想把数学接到实际建模上的学习者。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 建议先学微积分和线性代数；微分方程基础有帮助。
resources.why_recommended_zh: philzook在列出个人最喜欢的讲座时，明确说Strang的这组工程计算课改变了自己。

evidence.resource_title: MIT 18.085 Computational Science and Engineering I
evidence.quote: Gilbert Strang's Computational Methods for engineers was life changing for me. It is a two part MIT opencourse.
evidence.reason_zh: philzook对这门课有明确个人评价；没有把同评论其余未看过的课都当成体验。
evidence.author: philzook

resources.notes_zh: 该评论称整个系列为两部分；这里链接、计数的是18.085第一部分，未把18.086额外凑成一条。旧OCW路径保留原帖href。
resources.format_detail_zh: 大学公开课视频与习题

link_check.page_title: Computational Science and Engineering I | Mathematics | MIT OpenCourseWare

resources.title: Circuits and Electronics / MITx 6.002x
resources.provider: MITx / Anant Agarwal 等；edX 托管
resources.summary_zh: 从基础电路元件、分析与实际应用进入电子学，适合想从系统课程开始学习电路的人。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 建议高中物理、代数和基础微积分；应配合电路习题与仿真。
resources.why_recommended_zh: complex1314说它把自己带到全职EE道路上；microtherion赞讲课与辅导材料；tzs觉得它在器件理论和电路直觉之间平衡良好。

evidence.quote: Circuit and electronics MITx 6.002. Great lectures, a joy to watch. Put me on the path to EE full-time.
evidence.reason_zh: complex1314报告职业学习方向的个人影响。
evidence.author: complex1314

evidence.quote: Really outstanding class! Prof Agarwal was an excellent lecturer, the course material was well prepared, and lots of tutoring material was made available.
evidence.reason_zh: microtherion具体肯定教师、课程和辅导材料。
evidence.author: microtherion

evidence.quote: The "Circuits and Electronics" course struck for me a perfect balance.
evidence.reason_zh: tzs在比较其他课程后肯定这门课的平衡。
evidence.author: tzs

resources.notes_zh: 评论者早期上的单门课到2018年已拆为三个部分；入口保留原评论的第1部分历史edX链接，其余两部分在同一原评论中可查。没有把第1部分称作整个三部分都包含。 本次该历史edX入口返回404。下列MIT OCW 2007材料为另一个教学版本，可作延伸学习入口；不把它当成原edX课程仍然可报名的证明。
resources.format_detail_zh: 大学MOOC：电路基础、仿真及习题

related_urls.title_zh: MIT 6.002 Circuits and Electronics（2007 OCW，另一个教学版本）

resources.title: The Art of Electronics
resources.summary_zh: 面向实际电子电路设计，把元件、模拟和数字电路中的常见现实问题讲清楚，适合边做项目边学习的人。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 建议基础电路概念；配合实验、仿真和Learning the Art of Electronics实验手册更合适。
resources.why_recommended_zh: kurthr喜欢它补足理想化学术教材缺少的真实问题；zxexz认为它直观而信息丰富；vvanders因实际工程知识深度经常回看。

evidence.quote: I really liked The Art of Electronics by Horowitz and Hill, which has an associated lab book you could use for little projects. It covers a lot of real world issues that are missing from the more ideal academic books.
evidence.reason_zh: kurthr有电子学实践，喜欢本书的现实问题处理。
evidence.author: kurthr

evidence.quote: I can't recommend The Art of Electronics highly enough - it's way more intuitive and informative than any other resource on the subject I've found. It's exceptionally great when paired with the self-paced lab manual Learning the Art of Electronics[0]. [0] https://www.digikey.com/en/resources/edu/harvard-lab-kit
evidence.reason_zh: zxexz推荐教材，并说明与实验手册搭配。
evidence.author: zxexz

evidence.quote: I'll second this, despite the first version being written over 40 years ago it's still one of the best books I've seen on the subjects. The more recent versions bring it up to date well, it's a dense book but one I find myself coming back to more than any other for the incredible depth of practical engineering knowledge.
evidence.reason_zh: vvanders认可新版本更新和工程知识深度。
evidence.author: vvanders

resources.notes_zh: 教材与配套实验手册是不同出版物；这里只计主教材一条。评论中的旧实验套件供应有争议，未据此承诺材料包可购。官方书站已核对。

resource_url_source.basis_zh: 作者官方The Art of Electronics站，HTTP 200与第三版书名匹配。

resources.format_detail_zh: 电子学教材／工程参考书

link_check.page_title: The Art of Electronics 3rd Edition | by Horowitz and Hill

resources.title: Make: Electronics
resources.summary_zh: 用小实验逐步学习电子元件和基础电路，适合看理论读物难以进入、希望先做出东西的新手。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 按入门教材起点学习；需要基础元件和实验工具。
resources.why_recommended_zh: slindsey说读了很多都没有真正理解，直到按书动手才有进展；pensativo也用这条路线，再进阶到The Art of Electronics。

evidence.quote: This is what I'm working through and I like it. I've read a ton but nothing clicked until I started actually "doing". And the components are all available in kits. (Make: Electronics Components Pack 1, etc). You can get the stuff cheaper, but this puts it all together in one place for you.
evidence.reason_zh: slindsey正在按书做实验，体验在读并非已完成。
evidence.author: slindsey

evidence.quote: This and youtube is what I did. Later on, you can get "The Art of Electronics"
evidence.reason_zh: pensativo说明自己用过Make配YouTube的路径。
evidence.author: pensativo

evidence.quote: Make: Electronics is a good starter. https://www.makershed.com/products/make-electronics-2ed
evidence.reason_zh: sslnx提供具名教材的直接推荐和二版入口。
evidence.author: sslnx

resources.notes_zh: 链接来自2018年评论，指第2版；没有把旧版体验标成最新版本。元件包在历史评论中存在，不保证今天同样可买。
resources.format_detail_zh: 通过动手实验学习的电子学教材

resources.title: Audio Signal Processing for Music Applications
resources.provider: Universitat Pompeu Fabra、Stanford / Xavier Serra、Julius O. Smith；Coursera 托管
resources.summary_zh: 通过音乐音频理解数字信号分析、变换与合成，适合想把数学连接到可听实验的程序员。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 建议Python及基本线性代数、三角函数；信号处理基础可边学边补。
resources.why_recommended_zh: sleazy_b说自己原先几乎没有信号处理或音乐基础，仍学到很多；课程激发了其玩软件合成器和回头学习线性代数。

evidence.resource_title: Audio Signal Processing for Music Applications
evidence.quote: Kind of a random one but Coursera's Audio Signal Processing for Music Applications was a ton of fun. I had basically no exposure to either the signal processing or the music side of this course and still learned a ton. Inspired me to mess with software synthesizers as well as go back to linear algebra; opened up a whole bunch of avenues for
evidence.reason_zh: sleazy_b提供具体个人学习体验及后续实践兴趣。
evidence.author: sleazy_b

resources.notes_zh: 只找到一条明确个人推荐；不把该读者能够跟上直接当成官方无先修要求。官方Coursera入口已核对HTTP 200和课名。

resource_url_source.basis_zh: Coursera官方同名课程页；HTTP 200并匹配课名。

resources.title: Introduction to Linear Dynamical Systems / EE263
resources.summary_zh: 用线性代数理解动态系统、建模与分析，适合想把数学用于控制、时间序列或工程系统的读者。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 建议线性代数与微积分；微分方程基础有帮助。
resources.why_recommended_zh: siddboots多次看讲座后说自己在数据分析和预测中经常使用这些技术；gadiyar也说课程帮助其真正理解有关主题。

evidence.resource_title: Introduction to Linear Dynamical Systems / EE263
evidence.quote: I've also gone over those lectures a couple of times. I'm not even sure why I started watching them, since I knew absolutely nothing about linear dynamical systems before hand, but it really changed my life! It taught me techniques that I now use all the time, and I think are very neglected within my field (data analysis/forecasting).
evidence.reason_zh: siddboots报告反复学习及后续数据分析应用。
evidence.author: siddboots

evidence.resource_title: Introduction to Linear Dynamical Systems / EE263
evidence.quote: Some good ones from Stephen Boyd - helped me really grok the subjects.
evidence.reason_zh: gadiyar对Boyd两个具名系列给出正面体验；此条是其中Linear Dynamical Systems。
evidence.author: gadiyar

resources.notes_zh: 评论提供的是Stanford讲座播放列表；不是已核验今天仍开放注册的MOOC。第二条是同时称赞两个系列，未声称单独完成EE263。
